description: RFC 9727 / Robauto Day 1: advertise machine files on the homepage via Link.
notes: GitHub Pages cannot emit custom response headers. islandmountain.io is proxied by Cloudflare in front of Pages, so this rule lives on the existing zone ruleset 'Security response headers' (phase http_response_headers_transform).
Add this rule; do not replace the existing security-header rewrite.
After merge, Pages ships /.well-known/api-catalog. The Link header itself is this Transform Rule.

Link.value: <https://islandmountain.io/.well-known/api-catalog>; rel="api-catalog"; type="application/linkset+json", <https://islandmountain.io/.well-known/api-catalog>; rel="service-desc"; type="application/linkset+json", <https://islandmountain.io/faq.html>; rel="service-doc"; type="text/html", <https://islandmountain.io/llms.txt>; rel="describedby"; type="text/plain"
